checks.criterion: A single-file HTML5 canvas Snake game: arrow keys steer a snake that grows on eating food, food respawns, the game ends on wall/self collision, and a score is shown. All JS/CSS inline.
checks.rubric: 1.0 = a complete, playable Snake with growth, food respawn, collision game-over, and score; 0.5 = renders and moves but missing collision or score or growth; 0.0 = not a working snake game.
checks.describe: implements a real, playable Snake game
